product_metadata.title: Prepara Oven Safe Flexible Nonstick Kitchen Meat Roasting Rack, Red
features: Can be used with roasts, fish, root vegetables and more
Bendable shape allows you to mold to fit your needs
Heat resistant silicone up to 500° F/260° C
Keep your food out of the greasy fat at bottom of pan
description: This heat resistant silicone roasting aid keeps your bird or roast up and out of the unhealthy fats and the little burned bits in the bottom of your roasting pan or dish. It helps your roast to brown more evenly around the sides and eliminates sticking. The bendable shape allows you to mold your meat rack to fit your needs. This budget friendly alternative works with baking dishes and roasting pans of any material, size, or shape. It can be used with a slow cooker, microwave, and oven and is heat resistant silicone up to 500° F/260° C. It is easy to clean and dishwasher safe. Prepara tools are designed to enhance your cooking experience and simplify preparation with elegant designs and kitchen-tested performance.
